_comment: Hand written subjects for zones the automatic builder cannot describe. Each of these failed review because the zone's own standard names a rule or a place rather than a thing: 'floor and circulation path', 'paper and household backstock', 'surface rail and safety zone'. There is nothing in those sentences for a model to draw, so it renders the room and ignores the zone. These name the objects instead. Keep them concrete and countable, and keep them under about twenty words, because the encoder truncates at 77 tokens and the subject must survive.
entryway--door-mat-and-immediate-floor: a coir door mat on bare wood floor just inside a closed front door, nothing else on the floor
entryway--landing-zone: close up of a wooden tray on a table holding a set of car keys and a folded wallet
family-room--blanket-and-comfort-zone: a woven basket holding four folded throw blankets beside a sofa
family-room--board-game-and-puzzle-zone: close up of six board game boxes stacked flat on a wooden shelf

family-room--primary-media-zone: a wall mounted television above a low media console, remote controls in a small tray
